sentences.en: You are young. I, on the contrary, am very old.
sentences.zh: 你年轻。我恰恰相反，已经很老了。

sentences.en: "Have you finished it?" "On the contrary, I've just begun."
sentences.zh: "你完成了吗？" "恰恰相反，我才刚开始呢。"

sentences.en: "Have you finished it?" "On the contrary, I'm just starting."
